thread:
amy_cs: onboarding check-in for PrismLabs - their desktop app tests intermittently get 403s to /v1/chat. Server and CI calls fine.

amy_cs: they sent a curl example (token scrubbed):
```bash
curl -v https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_test_XXXX" -d '{"model":"rwd-2-mini","input":"hi"}'
```

amy_cs: When it fails they get HTTP/2 403 with JSON {"error":"invalid_auth","message":"token missing or invalid for this route"}. Request-ids: req_f7e, req_f7f.

kevin_eng: do they see a difference if they force http1.1? ask them to run `curl --http1.1 -v ...`.

amy_cs: they tried --http1.1 and it returns 200 every time. Electron uses a bundled http2 client library.

omar_net: likely header loss or case-sensitivity change at their proxy or the http2 shim. Some middleboxes lowercase headers or strip Authorization pseudoheaders.

kevin_eng: two quick mitigations: 1) set their desktop client to use HTTP/1.1 for now; 2) have infra allow Authorization passthrough. We'll also add an SDK flag to prefer http1.

amy_cs: customer ok with http1.1 workaround for onboarding, asked for a KB snippet.

omar_net: additional note for CS: ask them to capture raw http2 frames if possible or check proxy logs for header normalization. Also warn about concurrency: h2 multiplexing can make failures intermittent and mask the root cause.

kevin_eng: filing small SDK ticket to expose `preferHttp1` option and include an `X-Auth-Hint` header as a temporary nudge.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: eng-runtime/sdk-http1-workaround #1234 -> staging 2025-11-20T11:00:00Z

amy_cs: marking renewal-risk low; scheduling a 30m runbook review with customer and adding the curl repro to support ticket. Closing loop once KB is published.

omar_net: I'll draft the KB entry with repro steps and backoff guidance.

amy_cs: thanks team! :thumbsup:
